content.user_title: Manage CAPA Investigations and Action Plans
content.value_statement: CAPA work often stalls when investigations, actions, and evidence are not structured. This skill guides clear RCA, action planning, verification, metrics, and inspection-ready documentation.
actual_capabilities: Guides CAPA initiation, investigation, action planning, implementation, verification, and closure.
Recommends RCA methods such as 5 Why, fishbone, fault tree, human factors analysis, and FMEA.
Structures corrective, preventive, containment, and verification actions with owners, timelines, and success criteria.
Defines CAPA metrics including cycle time, recurrence rate, overdue rate, and first-time effectiveness.
Connects CAPA work to ISO 13485, FDA QSR, EU MDR, audits, training, and management review.
limitations: It provides guidance and drafting support, not certified regulatory or legal advice.
It depends on user-provided facts, records, metrics, and investigation evidence.
Included script, reference, and asset files are placeholders and do not automate a live CAPA system.
Final CAPA approval should remain with qualified quality, regulatory, and process owners.

use_cases.title: Launch a New CAPA
use_cases.description: Convert a complaint, audit finding, or nonconformance into a scoped CAPA record with clear next steps.

use_cases.title: Document Root Cause Analysis
use_cases.description: Select an RCA method and organize evidence, causes, contributing factors, and risk impact.

use_cases.title: Prepare Inspection Evidence
use_cases.description: Review CAPA status, effectiveness checks, recurrence data, and management review inputs before an audit.

prompt_templates.title: Create a CAPA Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a structured corrective action plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CAPA plan for this issue: [describe event]. Include containment, investigation scope, owners, timeline, and closure criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an RCA Method
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for method selection and investigation design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this quality issue and recommend the best RCA method. Explain why, list evidence needed, and draft the investigation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Verify CAPA Effectiveness
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an effectiveness verification plan for this CAPA. Include metrics, sample size, data sources, acceptance criteria, and escalation triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze CAPA Portfolio Trends
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for leadership reporting and systemic improvement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these CAPA records for trends. Summarize recurring causes, overdue actions, systemic risks, preventive actions, and management review messages.

output_examples.input: A recurring packaging defect increased after a supplier change.
output: Problem statement with affected products, dates, and defect rate.
Immediate containment actions for inventory, supplier lots, and customer risk.
Fishbone analysis focus areas covering supplier process, materials, inspection, training, and specifications.
Corrective actions with owners, dates, evidence, and verification metrics.

output_examples.input: A CAPA is ready for closure after process retraining.
output: Effectiveness check plan using recurrence rate, audit results, and operator competency records.
Acceptance criteria for closure and triggers for escalation.
Documentation checklist for training evidence, procedure updates, and management approval.

output_examples.input: Leadership needs a quarterly CAPA trend summary.
output: Cycle time, overdue CAPA rate, first-time effectiveness, and recurrence trends.
Top recurring root causes and affected process areas.
Preventive action opportunities and decisions needed from management.

best_practices: Provide specific facts, dates, affected products, records, and known constraints before asking for CAPA guidance.
Ask for measurable success criteria before implementation starts.
Review all outputs against company procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
anti_patterns: Do not use vague problem statements that hide scope, impact, or evidence gaps.
Do not close a CAPA based only on completed tasks without effectiveness data.
Do not treat generated regulatory language as final without qualified review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure CAPA investigations, RCA, action plans, verification checks, metrics, and quality-system reporting.

faq.question: Can it replace a quality manager?
faq.answer: No. It supports drafting and analysis, but accountable quality owners must approve CAPA decisions.

faq.question: Which regulations does it reference?
faq.answer: It references ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820.100, and EU MDR CAPA-related quality requirements.

faq.question: Does it connect to CAPA software?
faq.answer: No. The current files are guidance-focused and do not include a working integration.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the event description, evidence, affected process, risk impact, current controls, deadlines, and available metrics.

faq.question: Can it help with audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize CAPA evidence, status summaries, effectiveness checks, and management review points.
